_comment: mon.c m_respond_shrieker() summons with makemon(), whose appearance line is Norep() (makemon.c:1491-1499); pline.c vpline() (246-262) drops a no-repeat line equal to gp.prevmsg. makemon_create.js passes that line to its norepMessage owner, and the shriek handed it plain pline. A dwarvish Caveman wears an amulet of ESP and a blindfold, so sensemon() names monsters anywhere on the level, creates a shrieker beside him with ^G, and searches 20 turns at a time; each shriek interrupts the count and the space after it is an unknown command. The shriek at step 143 makes a sewer rat whose m_initgrp() companion prints the same far-away line, which C suppresses. Seed 9061403 is the first of 9061400-9061409 whose replay differs between the fixed and the unfixed port.
